Package dev.ucomprotocol.ap2

Record Class JwkKey

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.ucomprotocol.ap2.JwkKey
Record Components:
kid - Key identifier referenced in JWS headers.
kty - Key type (e.g., EC).
crv - Elliptic curve name (e.g., P-256, P-384, P-521).
x - Base64url-encoded X coordinate.
y - Base64url-encoded Y coordinate (for EC keys).
use - Public key use (typically sig).
alg - Intended JWS algorithm (e.g., ES256).
public record JwkKey(String kid, String kty, String crv, String x, String y, String use, String alg) extends Record
Public JSON Web Key (JWK, RFC 7517) published in /.well-known/ucp keys[] or configured as a trusted platform signing key for AP2 mandate verification.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
